Timely filing limits
* Version 2 applies to every claim received by the plan on or after 16 May 2027, whatever the date of service.
* A claim must be received by the plan no later than 120 days after the date of service.
* In computing any period under this section, the day of the service is not counted and the period ends at the end of its last day.
* Where the plan is the secondary payer, the filing period runs from the date of the primary payer's remittance advice.

R1. Monthly Uptime Percentage = (total minutes in the calendar month - Downtime minutes) / total minutes in the month x 100.
R2. Downtime excludes: (a) scheduled maintenance announced at least 48 hours in advance; (b) outages caused by the customer's own equipment, configuration or actions; (c) periods of degraded performance while the service remains available. Maintenance announced with less notice counts as Downtime.

R4. Service credits by Monthly Uptime Percentage: at or below 99.5% but above 99.0% -> 10% of the monthly fee; at or below 99.0% but above 98.0% -> 20% of the monthly fee; at or below 98.0% -> 30% of the monthly fee; otherwise no credit.
